section_title: US AML/CFT regulatory landscape > EU AML package

propositions.proposition: 6AMLD要求金融机构及其他义务实体实施全面的客户尽职调查程序、维护受益所有人中央登记册并开展风险评估。
source_quotes: The 6AMLD requires financial institutions and other obligated entities to implement comprehensive CDD procedures, maintain central registers of beneficial ownership information, and conduct risk assessments on state and supranational levels.

trigger_or_context: 金融机构及其他义务实体
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 实施全面的CDD程序、维护受益所有人中央登记册并开展风险评估

evidence_spans.quote: The 6AMLD requires financial institutions and other obligated entities to implement comprehensive CDD procedures, maintain central registers of beneficial ownership information, and conduct risk assessments on state and supranational levels.

propositions.proposition: 欧盟要求成员国将6AMLD条款转化为国内法。
source_quotes: The EU requires its member states to transpose 6AMLD provisions into law.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 成员国将6AMLD条款转化为国内法

evidence_spans.quote: The EU requires its member states to transpose 6AMLD provisions into law.

propositions.proposition: AMLR设定现金交易限额为10,000欧元，并加强政治敏感人物、受益所有人及披露规则。
source_quotes: This regulation sets a €10,000 limit for cash-based transactions and strengthens rules on PEPs, beneficial ownership, and beneficial owner disclosure obligations for firms in developing nations purchasing high-worth vehicles and real estate assets.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 设定10,000欧元限额并加强相关规则

evidence_spans.quote: This regulation sets a €10,000 limit for cash-based transactions and strengthens rules on PEPs, beneficial ownership, and beneficial owner disclosure obligations for firms in developing nations purchasing high-worth vehicles and real estate assets.

propositions.proposition: AMLR要求义务实体评估所有反洗钱人员的技能、声誉、诚实和正直。
source_quotes: AMLR requires obliged entities to assess all AML staff for skills, good repute, honesty, and integrity.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 评估所有反洗钱人员的技能、声誉、诚实和正直

evidence_spans.quote: AMLR requires obliged entities to assess all AML staff for skills, good repute, honesty, and integrity.

propositions.proposition: AMLR将义务实体范围扩展至足球经纪人、职业足球俱乐部和投资移民运营商。
source_quotes: AMLR expands the perimeter of obliged entities to include soccer agents, professional football clubs, and investment migration operators.

outcomes_or_paths: 包括足球经纪人、职业足球俱乐部和投资移民运营商

evidence_spans.quote: AMLR expands the perimeter of obliged entities to include soccer agents, professional football clubs, and investment migration operators.

propositions.proposition: AMLA-R设立欧盟反洗钱管理局，负责直接监督金融行业中基于高剩余风险选定的义务实体。
source_quotes: AMLA-R establishes an EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AML Authority, known as AMLA in Europe), which is responsible for the direct supervision of selected obliged entities in the financial sector.
These obliged entities are selected based on the high residual risk profile.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 设立欧盟反洗钱管理局并直接监督选定的义务实体
outcomes_or_paths: 选定的义务实体由AMLA直接监督

evidence_spans.quote: AMLA-R establishes an EU Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AML Authority, known as AMLA in Europe), which is responsible for the direct supervision of selected obliged entities in the financial sector.
These obliged entities are selected based on the high residual risk profile.

propositions.proposition: FTR落实FATF关于加密资产的建议，并禁止匿名加密资产账户和交易。
source_quotes: FTR implements FATF’s recommendations on cryptoassets and prohibits anonymous cryptoasset accounts and transactions.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 禁止匿名加密资产账户和交易

evidence_spans.quote: FTR implements FATF’s recommendations on cryptoassets and prohibits anonymous cryptoasset accounts and transactions.

propositions.proposition: 6AMLD增强了金融情报机构的作用，并加强了国家FIU与其他反洗钱当局之间的合作。
source_quotes: 6AMLD enhances the role of FIUs and strengthens cooperation between national FIUs and other AML authorities.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 增强金融情报机构作用并加强其与其他AML当局的合作

evidence_spans.quote: 6AMLD enhances the role of FIUs and strengthens cooperation between national FIUs and other AML authorities.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选s1c_001只承接6AMLD对义务实体的要求，没有承接6AMLD增强FIU角色和合作的独立处置链。

propositions.proposition: AMLR加强了可疑交易报告规则和违规处罚。
source_quotes: It also strengthens rules on SARs and penalties for violations.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 加强可疑交易报告规则和违规处罚

evidence_spans.quote: It also strengthens rules on SARs and penalties for violations.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选s1c_003覆盖了AMLR对现金交易限额和相关规则的加强，但没有承接AMLR加强可疑交易报告规则和违规处罚的独立处理。

propositions.proposition: AMLA-R负责协调国家主管机构的监督并起草二级法规和指南。
source_quotes: Additionally, AMLA-R coordinates supervision of NCAs and drafts level-2 regulations and guidelines.

candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 协调NCA监督和起草二级法规/指南

evidence_spans.quote: Additionally, AMLA-R coordinates supervision of NCAs and drafts level-2 regulations and guidelines.

gap_evidence.gap_reason: 已有候选s1c_006只承接AMLA-R设立并对义务实体直接监督，没有承接AMLA-R协调国家主管机构监督和起草二级法规/指南的独立职责。
